name: @hibernalglow/xaihi
description: Xaihi for DeepSeek Harness: a workspace extension framework — panel host, layout, Material You theme bridge, and node ecosystem. This is the publish-time entry package: once @hibernalglow/* is on a registry, installing it gives you the workbench (pnpm rewrites workspace:* on publish). Until then install @hibernalglow/xaihi-core and @hibernalglow/xaihi-ui as separate bundle rows - see docs/adr/0005-entry-bundle-reachability.md.
